originality.rationale: The source paper establishes the Koszul definitions, normal CAR and a spectral–essential coincidence only under additional norm convergence. Its normal lemma and Fredholm criteria are genuine ingredients; no direct theorem establishes the unconditional normal-class full classification together with optimal uniform lifting and sharp metric perturbation. published-finding corpus searches and own prior claims did not show coverage. Risk: a general prior Koszul/Hodge theorem may make some conclusions known.
residual_risks: The old infinite-family joint-spectral literature (especially 1974 Słodkowski–Żelazko) was not fully inspected; it may contain a deeper equivalent formulation.
The CAR proof mechanism and sharp contractive homotopy are classical enough that an older general homological statement could cover the normal result without the same terminology.
Originality remains a best-knowledge assertion, not independent priority certification.
